posts.trend: Bengaluru Metro Cost: Why Housing Access Still Falls Short
posts.context: Any new infrastructure announcement is instantly weaponized by real estate markets to justify rent hikes.
posts.angle: The metro line does not improve your transit; it merely justifies your landlord's next appraisal cycle.
